title: How Tracking Every Dollar for a Month Shows a Godly Man What He Worships
caption:
Your bank statement is more honest than your prayers.

Track every dollar for one month. Don't fix anything yet, just write it down. Then read it like a confession: where does the money go when you're bored, lonely, or up at midnight? Jesus said where your treasure is, your heart will be also. Pray over the list, cut one line, and give that money away the day you get paid.

Save this and start the list tonight.
